name: camera-bounds-paste
description: Enforce Camera Bounds on (the editor's default, we-drive pins it): a footman (2432, 0) and a pathless doodad LPcr (2432, -512) copied and pasted past the right camera bound (2816), inside the playable part (3328): the World Editor places both (3070.8, 0 and 3072.2, -510.5, 2026-11-14); Studio refused the paste before. The two objects already past the bound (3136) stay through the save. Input: tests/fixtures/we-compare/make-camera-bounds-input.mjs; the view is its first camera (2816, 0 from 3000), the clicks at 847,404 and 858,578 are 3072, 0 and 3072, -512 there. Expected MATCH (positions within 4: the two picks differ by a unit or two)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await s.look.get('map/war3map.w3e.txt')(2432, 0, { id: 'hfoo', x: 2432, y: 0 }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas').focus(); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.copy'); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.paste'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));

const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); await s.look.get('map/war3map.w3e.txt')(2432, -512, { id: 'LPcr', x: 2432, y: -512 }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); c.focus(); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.copy'); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.paste'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));

const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); const o = s.placedObjects(); if (o.units.filter((u) => u.id === 'hfoo').length !== 3 || o.doodads.length !== 3) throw new Error('the pastes past the camera bounds placed ' + (o.units.filter((u) => u.id === 'hfoo').length - 2) + ' footmen and ' + (o.doodads.length - 2) + ' doodads'); await w3.editors.saveAll();

name: camera-bounds-create
description: Enforce Camera Bounds on: what the switch does. Create Camera from the views of the input's cameras 2 to 7 (View Selected Camera first): the World Editor answers 'The current camera position is outside of the world camera bounds.' for the views whose target is past the camera bounds (3000, 0 inside the playable part; 0, 2900 with the eye inside; 2820, 0) and makes a camera for the others (2700, 0; 0, -3000 with the eye south of the map; 2700, 300 from 500): Camera 008 to 010. Studio's Cameras tab: Go to camera, View, Create from view, for the same six. Studio gives a new camera a far clipping of its distance + 3000 (the editor: 5000), left out here. Expected MATCH

steps.eval: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const jump = document.querySelector('select[title="Go to a camera"]'); if (!jump) throw new Error('no Cameras tab'); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && jump.options.length < 8; i++) await wait(250); for (const n of [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]) { const o = [...jump.options].find((o) => o.textContent === '00 we-drive look 0' + n); if (!o) throw new Error('no camera ' + n); jump.value = o.value; jump.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await wait(300); const view = [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-region-panel button')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'View'); if (!view) throw new Error('no View button'); view.click(); await wait(500); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-group-tools button')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Create from view').click(); await wait(800); } await w3.editors.saveAll();

name: camera-bounds-create-off
description: Enforce Camera Bounds off (Advanced > Enforce Camera Bounds, switched back before the save): Create Camera from the same six views makes all six, Camera 008 to 013, also the three past the camera bounds. Studio: the setting terrain.enforceCameraBounds off, the same six. The far clipping is left out as in camera-bounds-create. Expected MATCH

name: camera-bounds-typed
description: Enforce Camera Bounds on: a camera's typed target. The World Editor's Camera Properties (the camera's row, Return) puts a Target X typed past the camera bounds on the bound without a word: 3100 for the input's seventh camera (2700, 300 from 500) becomes 2816 (2026-11-14; with the switch off it stayed 3100). Studio's Cameras tab: Go to camera, 3100 typed into X. Expected MATCH

steps.eval: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const jump = document.querySelector('select[title="Go to a camera"]'); if (!jump) throw new Error('no Cameras tab'); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && jump.options.length < 8; i++) await wait(250); const o = [...jump.options].find((o) => o.textContent === '00 we-drive look 07'); if (!o) throw new Error('no camera 7'); jump.value = o.value; jump.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await wait(300); const x = document.querySelector('.terrain-camera-field input'); if (!x || Number(x.value) !== 2700) throw new Error('the X box shows ' + x?.value); x.value = '3100'; x.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await wait(800); await w3.editors.saveAll();
